articles.title: Bath Turns Fatal: DRDA Employee, Wife Die of Gas Geyser Suffocation in Pilibhit Home
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A government employee and his wife were found dead in their bathroom in Pilibhit on Sunday evening, in a suspected case of asphyxiation caused by a gas geyser. The incident occurred in Gurukul Puram Colony under the Kotwali police station area.

body.html:
A government employee and his wife were found dead in their bathroom in Pilibhit on Sunday evening, in a suspected case of asphyxiation caused by a gas geyser. The incident occurred in Gurukul Puram Colony under the Kotwali police station area.

The deceased were identified as Harjinder (42), a Class IV employee at the District Rural Development Agency (DRDA) in Vikas Bhawan, and his wife Renu Saxena (40). The couple lived in a rented house in the colony and had no children.

According to police, Renu had recently suffered a fracture in her arm and her plaster was removed on November 30. As she was still in pain, Harjinder was helping her with daily activities. On Sunday evening, he was bathing her in the bathroom with the gas geyser switched on.

When there was no response from the house for a long time, neighbours alerted the police. A team led by City Kotwal Satyendra Kumar reached the spot and found the bathroom door locked from inside. The door was broken open, and both were pulled out, but they had already died.

Initial investigation suggests that gas from the geyser led to oxygen depletion in the closed bathroom, causing suffocation. Both bodies have been sent for postmortem examination.

Additional Superintendent of Police Vikram Dahiya said forensic experts and a dog squad were called to the scene, and further investigation is underway to ascertain the exact cause of death.

Locals said Harjinder and Renu had a love marriage and were living alone in the rented house. The incident has left the colony in shock.

Doctors said gas geysers can emit carbon monoxide, a colourless and odourless but highly poisonous gas, especially in poorly ventilated spaces, which can lead to unconsciousness and death within minutes.

articles.title: Helmeted Man Thrashes Burqa-Clad Woman on Moradabad Road, Child Looks On in Horror
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking video from the Civil Lines area of Moradabad has gone viral, showing a helmeted man brutally assaulting a burqa-clad woman on a roadside, while a frightened young girl stands nearby. The incident reportedly took place on Sunday afternoon, December 21, 2025.

body.html:
A shocking video from the Civil Lines area of Moradabad has gone viral, showing a helmeted man brutally assaulting a burqa-clad woman on a roadside, while a frightened young girl stands nearby. The incident reportedly took place on Sunday afternoon, December 21, 2025.

The footage shows the man stopping a TVS bike, getting off, and attacking the woman who was riding pillion. He is seen kicking and punching her in a fit of rage as the young girl, believed to be their daughter, runs around in panic.

Passersby attempted to intervene and rescue the woman. Sources said the assailant is suspected to be her husband. A bystander recorded the incident and shared the video online, triggering widespread outrage on social media.

Despite the video surfacing from a high-security area like Civil Lines, police are yet to officially take cognisance of the matter. No arrests or formal statements have been issued so far. Authorities are expected to act soon as the clip continues to circulate widely.

articles.title: Doubting Paternity, Father Strangles 3-Year-Old Son to Death in Medak Horror
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a shocking incident that has sent waves of grief across Medak district, a man allegedly killed his three-year-old son on suspicion that the child was not his biological son. The incident occurred in Medak mandal.

body.html:
In a shocking incident that has sent waves of grief across Medak district, a man allegedly killed his three-year-old son on suspicion that the child was not his biological son. The incident occurred in Medak mandal.

According to police, the accused, Bhaskar, a resident of Peddabai Thanda, had married a woman from Thimmakkapalli Thanda six years ago. The couple, who survived on odd jobs, had frequent quarrels.

Recently, after a dispute, Bhaskar allegedly assaulted his wife, following which she went to her parents’ house, leaving the child with him. The boy had been staying with his father for the past two days.

Police said Bhaskar, suspecting that the child was not born to him, strangled the boy with a rope, killing him. On receiving information, Medak Rural police rushed to the spot and shifted the body to Medak Area Hospital for postmortem examination.

The accused has been taken into custody, and a case has been registered. Police said an investigation is underway.

The incident has triggered shock and mourning in the local area.

articles.title: Collapsed During Wudu: Mosque Committee Member’s Sudden Death Caught on CCTV in MP
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A senior member of the Jama Masjid committee died suddenly while performing ablution at the mosque in Hariganj area of Khandwa district in Madhya Pradesh. The incident, which occurred on Thursday night, was captured on CCTV cameras installed inside the mosque.

body.html:
A senior member of the Jama Masjid committee died suddenly while performing ablution at the mosque in Hariganj area of Khandwa district in Madhya Pradesh. The incident, which occurred on Thursday night, was captured on CCTV cameras installed inside the mosque.

The deceased was identified as Haji Sheikh Alim Thekedar (56), who had been associated with the Khandwa Jama Masjid committee for the past 20 years. He had come to the mosque to offer Isha prayers and was seen in the CCTV footage walking normally towards the Wudu Khana.

According to reports, he sat there waiting for the Adhan to end when he suddenly felt dizzy and collapsed. Eyewitnesses said he began gasping for breath within moments, and people present rushed to his help.

He was immediately taken to a nearby hospital, where doctors declared him dead after examination. Doctors have initially suspected a heart attack as the cause of death, though official confirmation is awaited.

The incident has cast a pall of gloom over the mosque premises and the locality. His funeral was held on Friday at the main cemetery, where a large number of people gathered to pay their last respects. Members of the mosque committee and local residents remembered him as a kind-hearted and devout person.

The CCTV footage of the incident has since surfaced on social media and drawn widespread attention.

articles.title: Love Marriage Turns Fatal: Husband Beats Wife to Death on CCTV in Telangana Dowry Horror
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 20-year-old woman was brutally beaten to death by her husband outside their house in Saipuri area of Tandur town in Telangana’s Vikarabad district, in an incident captured on CCTV that has gone viral on social media. The victim, Anusha, was assaulted by her husband Paramesh on Thursday.

body.html:
A 20-year-old woman was brutally beaten to death by her husband outside their house in Saipuri area of Tandur town in Telangana’s Vikarabad district, in an incident captured on CCTV that has gone viral on social media.

The victim, Anusha, was assaulted by her husband Paramesh on Thursday. In the footage, Anusha is seen sitting on a chabutara outside the house when Paramesh asks her to go inside. After she refuses, he slaps her, bangs her head against a wall, kicks her and repeatedly hits her with a thick wooden stick until she collapses. A passerby woman tried to intervene, but the attack continued.

According to police, Anusha, a native of Karanokota village in Tandur mandal, had married Paramesh, a tractor driver from the same locality, on March 12 this year after a love relationship, with the consent of both families. Her family had reportedly paid Rs 1.11 lakh as dowry.

However, within three months of marriage, Paramesh and his mother Lalamma allegedly began demanding additional dowry and harassing Anusha. Police said she was subjected to frequent domestic violence, and her mother-in-law often rebuked her over household issues.

As the harassment escalated, Paramesh’s father Mogilaiah reportedly dropped an injured Anusha at her maternal home on December 15. On December 18, when Anusha’s mother Chandramma was taking her to hospital, Paramesh intercepted them and forcibly took Anusha back.

Police said he took her to two hospitals, but left after being told it would be treated as a medico-legal case. He then brought her home, where an argument broke out after she refused to open the door and threw away the keys. Paramesh allegedly assaulted her with a stick, hitting her on the head multiple times.

Family members rushed Anusha to a private hospital, but she succumbed to her injuries on the way.

After the incident, Paramesh and his parents fled, but were later arrested by Vikarabad police. Based on Chandramma’s complaint, a case was registered.

Tandur Deputy Superintendent of Police Narsingh Yadaiah said Paramesh has been booked under Sections 101 (murder), 80 (dowry death) and 85 (husband subjecting a woman to cruelty) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). Further investigation is underway.

Police added that Anusha had not filed any earlier complaint, fearing repercussions.

articles.title: Newlywed Couple’s Train Deaths Take Shocking Turn: Fight Caught on Camera Before Fatal Fall
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A newly married couple from Andhra Pradesh died after falling from a moving train on the Vangapalli–Aler railway line in Yadadri Bhuvanagiri district of Telangana late on Thursday, December 18, 2025.

body.html:
A newly married couple from Andhra Pradesh died after falling from a moving train on the Vangapalli–Aler railway line in Yadadri Bhuvanagiri district of Telangana late on Thursday, December 18, 2025. The incident has drawn wide attention after a video, allegedly showing the couple arguing inside the train shortly before their deaths, surfaced on social media.

The deceased were identified as Korada Simhachalam (25) and his wife Bhavani (19), residents of Ravupalli village in Garugubilli mandal of Parvathipuram Manyam district. Married about two months ago, the couple had boarded the Machilipatnam Express at Secunderabad and were travelling to Vijayawada to visit relatives.

According to railway police, after the train crossed Vangapalli station in Yadagirigutta mandal, the couple was standing near the coach doorway when they fell from the moving train. The bodies were found early Friday morning by track maintenance staff and later shifted to a hospital for postmortem.

The case took a dramatic turn after a clip circulated online, purportedly recorded inside the train, showing the couple in a heated argument. Police are verifying the authenticity and timing of the video and have cautioned against drawing conclusions from unverified content.

Posts on social media claimed that Bhavani jumped from the train in a moment of distress after the argument, and Simhachalam followed in panic. However, police have not confirmed these claims and said all angles, including accident and *****, are being probed.

Officials said Simhachalam worked at a chemical company in Hyderabad and lived with his wife in the Gandhinagar area of Jagadgirigutta. A case has been registered, and investigation is underway.

articles.title: Pothole Kills Breadwinner: Family Refuses Funeral, Demands Justice in Nelamangala
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Nelamangala: A bike rider, Tabraiz (resident of Subhash Nagar), lost his life after attempting to avoid a pothole on the road, allegedly due to negligence by the Public Works Department and municipal authorities.

body.html:
Nelamangala: A bike rider, Tabraiz (resident of Subhash Nagar), lost his life after attempting to avoid a pothole on the road, allegedly due to negligence by the Public Works Department and municipal authorities. He sustained critical injuries in the fall and was admitted to NIMHANS, where he died during treatment.

Following his death, the family placed the body at their residence and announced a protest, refusing to perform the last rites until justice is assured. Tabraiz’s mother, Zarina, said he was the sole breadwinner, doing POP work, and was taking care of the family after her surgery. She demanded that the Deputy Commissioner visit the spot and ensure action.

Heavy police security has been deployed near the house to maintain law and order. The incident has renewed concerns over poor road maintenance and official negligence in the area.

articles.title: CCTV Shows Scooter Mows Down 4-Year-Old in Hapur, Rider on the Run
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Hapur (UP): A four-year-old girl, Pavitra, was seriously injured after being hit by a speeding scooter in Punjabi Colony on Railway Road under the Hapur Nagar Kotwali area on Friday evening.

body.html:
Hapur (UP): A four-year-old girl, Pavitra, was seriously injured after being hit by a speeding scooter in Punjabi Colony on Railway Road under the Hapur Nagar Kotwali area on Friday evening. She was playing outside her house when the scooter rammed into her, throwing her several feet into the air and causing severe head injuries. She has been admitted to hospital for treatment.

The rider fled the spot after the accident. The entire incident was captured on a nearby CCTV camera.

The victim’s mother, Saloni Kharbanda, has lodged a complaint at the city police station, demanding strict action. Circle Officer Varun Mishra and City SHO Devendra Bisht said a case will be registered, an investigation has begun, and efforts are on to identify and arrest the absconding rider.
